title: Decide profile-reference lifecycle and stale assessment handling
question: Once assessed_profile references can be versioned, authority-scoped, digest-backed, or signed as boundary need requires, how should retained assessed state treat profiles that are superseded, revoked, or no longer accepted?
why_now: rev0060 closes reference granularity with boundary-tiered binding. The next risk is time: an archived assessment may remain true under the profile used at assessment time while no longer being acceptable under current policy.
next_best_moves: Separate valid-under-assessed-profile from currently-accepted-under-policy without adding a policy lattice.
Test whether assessment time plus profile reference is enough for retained records.
Avoid turning profile reference into certification or revocation infrastructure unless a boundary earns it.
Keep lifecycle handling at local/export assessment rather than ordinary source packets.
